wire_nav.py.note: Two real defects found running it live against the committed site: (1) build() writes a plain nav with no aria-current marker, so a run silently stripped aria-current="page" from all 5 pages it touched, and the docstring's own usage instructions never mention wire_aria_current.py needing to follow; (2) the link-resolution scan crashed with an uncaught UnicodeDecodeError on a transient bad-encoding read (a concurrency artifact of this sandbox, not reproducible standalone), with no errors="replace" fallback unlike every comparable read-only scan elsewhere. Fixed: chains wire_aria_current.main() at the end, the read-only scan now uses errors="replace", and the rewrite loop catches UnicodeDecodeError per file (names it, skips it, fails the run rather than silently continuing).
